comparison.objective: Identify the pressure gauge reading in its red zone and place a red tag before it.
comparison.physical_skill: Read similar dials, select the anomalous gauge, and place a tag at its associated spot.
comparison.success_condition: Tag center lies within the left gauge's spot and no more than 2 cm above its resting surface; other placements score zero.
comparison.reason: Visual inspection and tag placement do not test any fracture, impact-force, retained-component, or fragment-containment ability.
